messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate detected on inference gateway (us-west-2). 5xx spike from model-runner group. Threshold breached 5m ago.

carlos (oncall): ack. I'm on it. paging now. @megan can you pull logs and stack traces?

megan (eng-sre): pulling logs — seeing repeated SIGSEGV from model-runner container (quant-kernel) + OOM kills on a subset of pods. Initial footprint spike before crash.

priyanka (eng-runtime): same here. Crash happens during KV cache write for long-context requests (>1k tokens). suspect kv growth + unchecked index write. quick stack:

```
# short trace excerpt
runtime: SIGSEGV
libquant.so 0x7f8b2a1c kernel_write+0x4f
model_runner 0x55a1d3 kv_cache_update
model_runner 0x55a1e2 forward
```

megan (eng-sre): that matches. Affected pods: model-runner-7/9 in us-west-2 pool. 5xx rate ~9% overall, many 502/504 at gateway.

devops-bot: Noted. Autoscaler kicked but pods fail on start due to immediate segfault.

carlos (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) throttle/gate large sequences at LB 2) reroute traffic to fallback model variant 3) canary hotfix build. I'll do 1+2 now.

megan (eng-sre): applying connection throttle on gateway: set max_conns=200 and max_req_size=120k.

megan (eng-sre): initiating route change: shift traffic for model-id redwood/gpt-large:stable -> redwood/gpt-large:compat-small in us-west-2, 100% for public customers, keep dedicated tenants pinned. Command: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://console/api/routes/reroute -d '{"model":"gpt-large","to":"gpt-large-compat-small","region":"us-west-2"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

devops-bot: Reroute queued, applying now.

anna (support): Customer-impact: seeing 25 open tickets mentioning 502/timeout; CS sent status page update. Major customers A,B affected intermittently.

tom (product): confirm we're not silently downgrading dedicated SLA customers? need to keep enterprise pinned.

carlos (oncall): confirmed — dedicated contracts untouched, only public-hosted routes rerouted.

priyanka (eng-runtime): building hotfix that adds bounds checks in kv cache write + backpressure. image: runner:r749-hotfix. will canary 10% after build.

megan (eng-sre): canary started at 10% in us-west-2. telemetry hooks live. watch 5xx and oom counts.

incident-bot: Alert: 5xx rate decreased from 9% -> 2% within 8m of reroute and throttling. OOMs reduced from 6/min -> 0.

carlos (oncall): good delta. still see occasional segfault on older nodes, probably stale images. evict and respawn those nodes from pool. megan, can you cordon node-az3-07?

megan (eng-sre): cordon + drain in progress for node-az3-07. replacing with fresh instance.

priyanka (eng-runtime): hotfix image passed unit + integration tests, rolling to 25% then 100% once stable.

anna (support): updating customers in impacted list: sent targeted notes to top 5 accounts, added ETA: mitigation in progress; next update in 30m.

carlos (oncall): going to prep handoff notes — I'll hand to night oncall @julia in 30m. key items: reroute in place, hotfix rolling (r749-hotfix), nodes being replaced, postmortem required for kv-cache growth.

julia (oncall-night): ack, will take over. please leave exact commands + links in incident doc.

megan (eng-sre): final status for now: 5xx stabilized ~1.6% (within threshold), canary healthy. marking incident as mitigated for customer-facing updates.

carlos (oncall): thanks team. follow-ups: postmortem owner: @priyanka, include perf regression tests for long seqs, add kv size alerts. I'll add to incident tracker. handing off. :thumbsup:

julia (oncall-night): taking over. ping me if anything regresses.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated (status: partial). Root cause suspected: unbounded KV cache write path in quant kernel causing memory corruption -> segfaults/ooms. Next steps: postmortem, hotfix full rollout, infra node replacement, targeted regression tests.
